newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil condemns Jerusalem suicide bombings.
newsitem.headline: Brazil condemns Jerusalem suicide bombings.

text.p: The Brazilian government condemned Wednesday's suicide bombing attack in Jerusalem and urged Israel and Palestine not to give up their quest for peace in the region.

"Acts such as these deserve total repulsion," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement. "The Brazilian government hopes reason will continue to prevail and that Israeli and Palestinian leaders will press on with the peace negotiations."

In a letter to his Israeli counterpart Ezer Weizmann, Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso said the South American nation "condemns and repudiates in the most vehement terms this terrorist act."
Fifteen people died and about 150 were injured when two Arab suicide bombers set off explosions in a west Jerusalem market, dealing a blow to efforts by the United States to restore peace talks.
